query:
WITH city_population AS (
    SELECT 
        TRIM(hl.city) AS city,
        TRIM(hl.region) AS region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS population
    FROM 
        estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala p
    JOIN 
        estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON p.id = hl.id
    WHERE 
        p.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
        AND p.is_in_population = TRUE
    GROUP BY 
        TRIM(hl.city), TRIM(hl.region)
),
city_size_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        city,
        region,
        population,
        CASE 
            WHEN population >= 500000 THEN 'كبارى (أكثر من 500 ألف)'
            WHEN population >= 100000 THEN 'متوسطة (100 ألف - 500 ألف)'
            ELSE 'صغيرة (أقل من 100 ألف)'
        END AS city_size_category
    FROM 
        city_population
)
SELECT 
    city_size_category,
    COUNT(*) AS city_count,
    SUM(population) AS total_population
FROM 
    city_size_categories
GROUP BY 
    city_size_category
ORDER BY 
    total_population DESC
LIMIT 1000
